question:
**In the given sentence, one word may have been incorrectly spelt. Select the correctly spelt word from the given alternatives. If there is no error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.**

The staff members were attempting to manoeuvre the board of directors for the abolition of pay disparity
solution:
The correct answer is** 'no error'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In this question, we have to check whether any part of the sentence has any spelling error and if there is then we will select that option, if there is no error, then option 4 is the correct answer.
 
• The spelling of '**manoeuvre**' in the given sentence is correct and so the options given for the word are null and void.
 
• **Manoeuvre **means** a movement or series of moves requiring skill and care**. (कौशल और देखभाल की आवश्यकता वाले चालों की एक गति या श्रृंखला)
 
 
• *Example: Snowboarders performed daring **manoeuvres **on precipitous slopes.*
